+"""Control log and helpers for the BEHAVIOR-1K limited-mode table-setting episode."""
+import json, pathlib, sys, time
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+RUNS = pathlib.Path("/app/runs")
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+RUNS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+print("SPEC", json.dumps(spec, indent=2), flush=True)
+print("STATUS", r.status(), flush=True)
+obs = r.get_obs(video="frames")
+print("OBS META", json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2), flush=True)
+
+def save_obs(o, name="obs"):
+    d = OUT / name
+    d.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, im in o.last.items():
+        fn = cam.split(":")[1].replace("_link", "")
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(d / f"{fn}.png")
+    if o.proprio is not None:
+        np.save(d / "proprio.npy", o.proprio)
+    (d / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(o.meta, indent=2))
+    print("saved", d, flush=True)
+
+save_obs(obs, "initial")
+
+def step(kind, actions, dt=1/30, interpolate="linear", note=""):
+    global obs
+    res = r.submit(kind, actions, dt=dt, interpolate=interpolate, video="both", note=note)
+    print("RESULT", json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2), flush=True)
+    obs = res
+    save_obs(obs, f"step_{int(time.time())}")
+    return res
+
+def observe(seconds=0, video="both"):
+    global obs
+    obs = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video=video)
+    print("OBS META", json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2), flush=True)
+    save_obs(obs, f"observe_{int(time.time())}")
+    return obs
+
+def joints():
+    p = obs.meta.get("proprio")
+    print(json.dumps(p, indent=2) if isinstance(p, dict) else p, flush=True)
+    return p
+
+def show_status():
+    s = r.status()
+    print(json.dumps(s, indent=2), flush=True)
+    return s
+
+print("READY: r, spec, obs, step(), observe(), joints(), show_status()", flush=True)

"""Control log and helpers for the BEHAVIOR-1K limited-mode table-setting episode."""
import json, pathlib, sys, time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
RUNS = pathlib.Path("/app/runs")
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
RUNS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
print("SPEC", json.dumps(spec, indent=2), flush=True)
print("STATUS", r.status(), flush=True)
obs = r.get_obs(video="frames")
print("OBS META", json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2), flush=True)

def save_obs(o, name="obs"):
    d = OUT / name
    d.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for cam, im in o.last.items():
        fn = cam.split(":")[1].replace("_link", "")
        Image.fromarray(im).save(d / f"{fn}.png")
    if o.proprio is not None:
        np.save(d / "proprio.npy", o.proprio)
    (d / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(o.meta, indent=2))
    print("saved", d, flush=True)

save_obs(obs, "initial")

def step(kind, actions, dt=1/30, interpolate="linear", note=""):
    global obs
    res = r.submit(kind, actions, dt=dt, interpolate=interpolate, video="both", note=note)
    print("RESULT", json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2), flush=True)
    obs = res
    save_obs(obs, f"step_{int(time.time())}")
    return res

def observe(seconds=0, video="both"):
    global obs
    obs = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video=video)
    print("OBS META", json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2), flush=True)
    save_obs(obs, f"observe_{int(time.time())}")
    return obs

def joints():
    p = obs.meta.get("proprio")
    print(json.dumps(p, indent=2) if isinstance(p, dict) else p, flush=True)
    return p

def show_status():
    s = r.status()
    print(json.dumps(s, indent=2), flush=True)
    return s

print("READY: r, spec, obs, step(), observe(), joints(), show_status()", flush=True)
